items.summary: Risk disposition: blocked for public launch, rights-dependent monetization, and security-sensitive release; conditional for ordinary reversible growth within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, age-sensitive, and data-handling boundaries. Exact decision: retain SearchWoot private, keep permission outreach unsent, and continue only existing read-only evidence work. Evidence: Woot terms do not establish commercial/public redistribution rights; all four launch-readiness tasks remain open; accuracy/freshness, measurement/attribution, and security gates are blocked; compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown. Human counsel is required for Woot rights, jurisdictional privacy/consent treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary reversible growth.

Launch-readiness tracking remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 open. No task is closable on current evidence. Progress is limited to official-source, repository/configuration, privacy-policy, and cookie-policy artifacts. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only evidence bundle and field-level rights matrix covering provenance, permitted storage/caching/display/derivatives, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, identifiers, retention, deletion, access, notification consent, unsubscribe behavior, GA4 settings, log fields, vendor coverage, and incident/request procedures.

Site-specific compliance decisions remain unchanged: retain complicated.work parked until banner, consent accept/reject, and GA4 failures are remediated; retain deadlymaracas.com parked until DNS reachability and a concrete compliance checklist are evidenced. Ordinary growth elsewhere may proceed only within existing consent, disclosure, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries. Preserve the $4.92 aggregate commission as unattributed; make no revenue, ROI, margin, payback, or causal-lift claims.
